subject: Next steps: Crestwell vendor intake, security checklist, and PO timing
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clark <evan.clark@crestwellhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Next steps: Crestwell vendor intake, security checklist, and PO timing

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while you loop in procurement and security: 

- Decision criteria you emphasized: latency SLA, on-prem VPC support, and audit log retention (7 years).
- Economic buyer: you noted Marta (finance) and Rajiv (CTO) as final approvers.
- Procurement asks you flagged: standard vendor packet + SOC 2 evidence and PO template.

Can you confirm the following so we can prepare the documents?
1) Preferred PO holder name and billing address (legal entity)
2) Any vendor onboarding portal link or intake form we should submit into (procurement@crestwellhealth is fine if not)
3) Target cutover month for pilot (you mentioned late Jan)

Attachments: Redwood-vendor-packet.pdf (vendor intake summary), SOW-crestwell-v1.docx (initial scope), PO-template-crestwell.xlsx (sample).

If helpful, I can prepare a short Mutual Action Plan and a single-sheet security evidence index for Marta.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

From: Evan Clark <evan.clark@crestwellhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@crestwellhealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@crestwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: Crestwell vendor intake, security checklist, and PO timing

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the summary. Confirming a few items from our side:
- PO holder: Crestwell Health Systems, Inc. / 1204 Harbor St., Seattle, WA 98101
- Intake: Procurement prefers we upload into Coupa first; however, we can accept a direct vendor packet to procurement@crestwellhealth.com while I start the Coupa ticket.
- Target: pilot kickoff week of 2027-01-25, internal approvals by 2027-01-12.

Marta — looping you for SOC 2 and invoice cadence questions; Rajiv will need the SOW and an initial latency SLA line-item to review.

Evan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:23:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: Crestwell vendor intake, security checklist, and PO timing

Folks — forwarding Evan's confirmation. Action items for our side before Evan's approvals window: 

- Marissa: can you prepare the short security evidence index (SOC 2 report summary + list of audit logs we retain and retention windows) by EOD Thursday? I put the SOC 2 executive summary in the vendor packet but we should surface retention details.
- Jonas: please draft the latency SLA blurb and a fallback plan (model variant routing + regional failover) — Rajiv wants one paragraph he can paste into the SOW.
- Rishi: check finance: confirm if we can accept Crestwell's PO-template tweaks (they often change payment net terms). If not, what minimums do we need to accept?

I'll attach the current vendor packet and SOW draft for reference.

Thanks — will follow up after internal updates and then send a single consolidated package to Evan / Marta / procurement.

Best,
Laura

Subject: Crestwell vendor intake: onboarding form and required fields

Hi Laura —

Attached is our vendor intake form (Coupa import CSV preferred). Required fields we need completed: legal entity, tax ID/EIN, bank remit info, W-9 (if US), primary contact for invoices, and insurance certificate (if available).

Please upload the vendor_packet + W-9 and complete the Coupa import sample by 2026-12-15 so we can hit the approval window. If you prefer we can accept the packet by email and procurement will enter it for you — let us know.

Attachments: crestwell-vendor-intake.xlsx (form), sample-coupa-import.csv

Thanks,
Crestwell Procurement

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Crestwell vendor intake: onboarding form and required fields

Hi all —

Thanks — we'll complete the Coupa import sample and upload the vendor packet + W-9 by 2026-12-14. Quick notes on internal commitments: 

- Marissa: SOC 2 executive summary and retention matrix arriving 12/11 EOD.
- Jonas: SLA blurb + fallback paragraph arriving 12/12.
- Rishi/Finance: confirmed we can accept Crestwell's PO-template with net-30; exceptions routed to finance lead for review.

Laura (on behalf of Redwood) — please expect the final package and Coupa CSV from me by Tuesday 12/14; we appreciate the quick turnaround to keep the Jan pilot target.
